keys.effect: Internal render resolution formatted as (Width, Height).
keys.notes: Once Human natively scales horizontal field of view (Hor+) for 21:9 and 32:9 aspect ratios. Can be overridden to (3840, 1440) or (2560, 1440) for GPU-centered pillarboxed play.

keys.effect: Screen safe-zone and UI boundary margin padding from physical display bezels.
keys.notes: Crucial on 32:9 super ultrawide monitors (5120x1440) to pull minimap, status bars, and quest log inward from the physical edges into a comfortable 21:9/16:9 viewing field.

keys.effect: Toggles camera and object motion blur (0 = Off, 1 = On).
keys.notes: Always recommended 0 (Off). Motion blur on high refresh ultrawides creates rapid peripheral visual distortion and is the primary trigger for simulator sickness.

keys.effect: Window presentation mode: 0 = Windowed, 1 = Borderless Windowed, 2 = Fullscreen.
keys.notes: Borderless Windowed provides smooth alt-tabbing, avoids resolution reset glitches on multi-monitor setups, and supports window centering utilities.

keys.effect: NVIDIA DLSS upscaler mode: 0 = Off, 1 = Ultra Performance, 2 = Performance, 3 = Balanced, 4 = Quality.
keys.notes: Requires setting_enable_d3d12=1. DLSS Quality provides exceptional anti-aliasing on dense vegetation and fine mesh wireframes at 1440p+ while delivering 30-40% higher frame rates.

keys.effect: NVIDIA DLSS 3 Frame Generation toggle (0 = Off, 1 = On).
keys.notes: Requires GeForce RTX 40-series GPU, DX12, and Windows Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS). Generates intermediate frames to push frame rates into 140-240 FPS territory.

keys.effect: NVIDIA Reflex Low Latency system toggle (0 = Off, 1 = On).
keys.notes: Mandatory when DLSS 3 Frame Generation is active. Keeps GPU render queue minimal to reduce input lag.

keys.effect: NVIDIA Reflex operational mode: 0 = Off, 1 = On, 2 = On + Boost.
keys.notes: Mode 1 optimizes latency with standard GPU clock scaling; Mode 2 pins GPU clocks higher during CPU-limited scenarios.

keys.effect: NeoX engine render queue low latency synchronization flag (0 = Off, 1 = On).
Camera roll and tilt when leaning around obstacles or aiming (0 = Off, 1 = On).
keys.notes: Recommended 0 for motion_comfort; camera roll without physical vestibular cueing induces motion sickness in sensitive individuals.

keys.effect: Surface texture resolution and mipmap quality level (0 = Low, 1 = Medium, 2 = High).
keys.notes: VRAM-bound. Level 2 (High) requires approximately 8-10 GB VRAM allocation at 5120x1440; comfortably supported by 12GB+ GPUs with zero compute overhead.

keys.effect: Cascaded shadow map resolution and filtering quality (0 = Low, 1 = Medium, 2 = High).
Screen-space directional contact shadows (0 = Off, 1 = On).
Screen-space specular reflections on wet roads, puddles, and glass (0 = Off, 1 = On).
World object Level-of-Detail (LOD) draw distance and mesh density.
keys.notes: High detail distance significantly pushes out geometry pop-in distance, critical for maintaining visual stability across wide 32:9 horizons.

keys.effect: Vegetation and ground foliage clutter density.
In-engine double-buffer vertical synchronization toggle (0 = Off, 1 = On).
keys.notes: Always recommended 0 (Off). Rely on monitor G-Sync / FreeSync VRR to prevent judder and tearing without incurring frame presentation lag.

keys.effect: Frame rate cap preset (1 = 30, 2 = 60, 3 = 120, 4 = Uncapped/240Hz).
Enables DirectX 12 graphics backend (0 = DX11, 1 = DX12).
keys.notes: Mandatory to unlock DLSS, DLSS 3 Frame Generation, and multi-core CPU command recording.

keys.effect: Text chat window font size multiplier (0 = Default, 1 = Medium, 2 = Large).
keys.notes: Recommended 1 or 2 for high-resolution 1440p and ultrawide displays to improve legibility and reduce eye strain.

keys.effect: Spoken dialogue subtitle font scaling preset (0-4).

manual_only_settings.reason: Eliminates violent camera jolting during weapon firing and detonations, essential for motion_comfort.
Pulls third-person perspective back to prevent the character model from blocking the crosshair and broadens immediate field awareness.

manual_only_settings.recommendation: Adjust to pull HUD into 21:9 / 16:9 bounds
manual_only_settings.reason: Eliminates extreme head turning on 32:9 displays by bringing vital HUD elements toward the center gaze.
